summary: The board starts right under the window buttons
notes: The title bar is gone: only the window buttons stay, over the board
Updates download in the background; the Update button in the title bar's corner says what got better
Edits made a second before quitting are saved
Quitting takes about 2 seconds instead of 11
A drag across the board no longer selects its labels; card text, docs and chat still can be selected
Selected text in a goal is readable
